sections.title: Ibitekerezo by'ibanze
items: Nzi icyo ibintu (matter) ari cyo.
Nshobora gusobanura itandukaniro hagati y'ibintu n'ibitari ibintu.
Nzi icyo atomi ari cyo.
Nzi icyo molekile ari cyo.
Nzi icyo ikintu fatizo ari cyo.
Nzi icyo ikinyabutabire ari cyo.
Nshobora gutanga urugero rw'ikintu fatizo n'urw'ikinyabutabire.

sections.title: Volumu na misa
items: Nzi icyo volumu isobanura.
Nzi icyo misa isobanura.
Nzi itandukaniro hagati ya misa n'uburemere.
Nzi ko litiro 1 = 1 dm³.
Nzi ko 1 ml = 1 cm³.
Nshobora gusobanura uko dupima volumu y'ikintu kidafite ishusho ihamye (urugero: ibuye).
Nzi ibipimo bikoreshwa ku misa (g, hg, kg).

sections.title: Ubucucike
items: Nzi icyo ubucucike busobanura.
Ndumva ko ibintu bitandukanye bifite ubucucike butandukanye.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu litiro 5 z'isasu (lead) ziruta litiro 5 z'amata uburemere.
Nzi ko ubucucike bushingira ku buryo atomi zipfunditse hafi y'izindi.

sections.title: Umuriro w'amashanyarazi
items: Nzi ko elegitoroni zifite umuriro wa negatifu.
Nzi ko nucleus y'atomi ifite umuriro wa pozitifu.
Nzi icyo amashanyarazi ahagaze (static electricity) ari cyo.
Nzi ko imiriro itandukanye ikurura naho imiriro imeze kimwe igasunika.
Nshobora gutanga urugero rwo mu buzima bwa buri munsi (urugero: gusokoza umusatsi, inkuba).

sections.title: Imbaraga na surface tension
items: Nzi ko imbaraga zifatanya ibintu.
Nzi icyo surface tension (imbaraga zifata ubuso bw'amazi) ari cyo.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu udukoko tumwe dushobora kugenda hejuru y'amazi.
Nzi uko isabune y'ibikoresho igira ingaruka kuri surface tension.

sections.title: Ibitekerezo ku bintu (mu mateka)
items: Nzi Demokritos uwo ari we n'icyo igitekerezo cye cya atomi cyavugaga.
Nzi icyo Aristoteles yatekerezaga ku bintu (ibintu bine by'ibanze).
Nzi icyo Einstein yasobanuye akoresheje imigendere ya Brown (Brownian motion).
Nzi icyo ubushakashatsi kuri nano (nanotechnology) bwibanda.
Nzi icyo nanometero ari cyo.

sections.title: Iterambere rirambye (mu ncamake)
items: Ndumva ko ibintu bitarangira ahubwo bihindura ishusho gusa.
Nzi ko ibintu bimwe bishobora kwangiza ibidukikije (urugero: DDT).
